verified_facts.text: Carmel Valley Ranch is a resort set on 500 acres in California.
verified_facts.excerpt: LUXURY CALIFORNIA RESORT ON 500 ACRES

verified_facts.text: The resort sits in the foothills of Monterey's Santa Lucia Mountains, about eight miles inland from the Pacific Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: The foothills of Monterey’s Santa Lucia Mountains, about eight miles inland from the Pacific Ocean

verified_facts.text: Every room at the resort is a suite, with options to connect suites with up to four bedrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every room at The Ranch is a suite, perfectly equipped for play.

verified_facts.text: Suites have fireplaces, private decks and spa-inspired bathrooms with aromatherapy amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy romantic fireplaces, private decks, spa-inspired bathrooms with aromatherapy amenities, and plenty of space

verified_facts.text: The 18-hole golf course was designed by Pete Dye and is a bentgrass, par-70 layout.
verified_facts.excerpt: The only Pete Dye-designed bentgrass golf course in Northern California is right here at Carmel Valley Ranch

verified_facts.text: Golf holes range from riverside par-3s to par-5s winding into the foothills of the Santa Lucias.
verified_facts.excerpt: With holes ranging from riverside par-3s to challenging par-5s winding into the foothills of the Santa Lucias

verified_facts.text: Resident artisans craft cheese with milk from the ranch's own goats, grow grapes for its own wines and press oil from its own olives.
verified_facts.excerpt: Here, artisans craft cheese with milk from our own goats, grow grapes for our own wines, press oil from our own olives.

verified_facts.text: The resort has a two-acre organic garden and orchard that supplies its kitchens with fruits, vegetables, flowers and herbs.
verified_facts.excerpt: As overseer of The Ranch’s two-acre organic garden and orchard, Mark grows the fruits, vegetables, flowers, and herbs that provide the resort’s kitchens

verified_facts.text: The resort has a four-acre working vineyard.
verified_facts.excerpt: the resort boasts a four-acre working vineyard

verified_facts.text: Guests can meet the resort's herd of goats and alpacas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Goats, alpacas and the rest of our herd offer the chance to both learn and make new friends.

verified_facts.text: Guests can step into the apiary in the organic garden, which also has chickens and a salt house.
verified_facts.excerpt: Along with chickens and a salt house, the organic garden is home to a rainbow of veggies, flowers, and honeybees—suiting up and stepping into the apiary was a highlight of my stay.

verified_facts.text: Daily activities range from guided hikes and yoga to archery lessons and picnics with a pair of resident miniature donkeys.
verified_facts.excerpt: Daily activities range from guided hikes and yoga to archery lessons and picnics with Pablo and Paco, a pair of resident miniature donkeys.

verified_facts.text: Spa Aiyana has 12 treatment rooms and suites, most with private outdoor terraces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our feel-good getaway offers 12 treatment rooms and suites—most with private outdoor terraces

verified_facts.text: Spa Aiyana facilities include a saltwater pool, an infinity hot tub, locker rooms with eucalyptus steam and a co-ed warming room.
verified_facts.excerpt: including our saltwater pool, infinity hot tub, men’s and women’s locker rooms with eucalyptus steam, and co-ed warming room

verified_facts.text: All spa facilities are designed for adult use; the minimum age for massages is 18.
verified_facts.excerpt: All spa facilities are designed for adult use. Minimum age for facials is 16 years old and minimum age for massages is 18 years old.

verified_facts.text: River Ranch is the main activity hub, with the Family Pool, a children's wading pool and splash pad, tennis and pickleball courts and an adult pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: It’s home to the Family Pool, as well as our new children’s wading pool and splash pad, tennis and pickleball courts, an adult pool

verified_facts.text: The Adventure Den offers activities for children aged 2 to 12, with a new theme each day of the week.
verified_facts.excerpt: Offering age-appropriate activities for Adventure Tots (2-5) and Adventure Kids (5-12)

verified_facts.text: Dogs are welcome, with a special program that includes a bed, treats and pooch room service.
verified_facts.excerpt: our special program just for dogs includes a comfy bed, treats, and more. We’ve even got pooch room service!

verified_facts.text: Signature restaurant Valley Kitchen showcases fresh, local ingredients, many grown or produced at the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Menus at signature restaurant Valley Kitchen showcase fresh, local ingredients—many of which are grown or produced at the resort.

verified_facts.text: Swaths of lavender bloom on the resort grounds every summer and are used in custom-made toiletries.
verified_facts.excerpt: Swaths of lavender erupt on resort grounds every summer, and it’s showcased in custom-made toiletries.

verified_facts.text: Room views vary from the valley and golf course to vineyards and oak trees, some of which filter a view of the Lodge and the adjacent parking lot.
verified_facts.excerpt: Room views vary from the valley and golf course to vineyards and stretches of oak trees that filter the view of The Lodge and the adjacent parking lot

verified_facts.text: The property is spread out and paths can be hilly, though they are paved.
verified_facts.excerpt: The property is spread out; paths can be hilly, but they are paved

verified_facts.text: Point Lobos State Natural Reserve is just under a nine-mile drive, and Carmel-by-the-Sea is about as close.
verified_facts.excerpt: Point Lobos State Natural Reserve is just shy of a nine-mile drive. Charming Carmel-by-the-Sea is equally as close.

verified_facts.text: Carmel Valley Ranch opened as a private golf club in 1981 and became a resort in 1987.
verified_facts.excerpt: Originally opened as a private golf club in 1981, Carmel Valley Ranch became a resort in 1987.

verified_facts.text: Guests can join a Falconry experience as part of spring Saturday programming.
verified_facts.excerpt: A Bee’s Life, Hilltop Meet & Greet, and our signature Falconry experience

verified_facts.text: Wellness baths designed by the Bath Butler can be drawn in the suite, and in outdoor tubs depending on room type.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by our Bath Butler and drawn by a spa attendant, our wellness baths offer a multitude of benefits based on your desires and preferences. Depending on your room type, they can even be enjoyed in our outdoor tubs.
